measurements: Throw measures about 51 x 55” [129.5 x 139.5 cm]
gauge: One Hexagon = 12” [30.5 cm] measured from point to point. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HEXAGON I
With A, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in ring, [ch 2 (for corner), sc in ring] 5 times, ch 2; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc and 6 corner ch-2 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 2: Draw up a loop of K in any corner ch-2 space, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in same corner ch-2 space, (sc, ch 2, sc) in each of remaining 5 corner ch-2 spaces; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc and 6 corner ch-2 spaces (2 sc in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces).
Round 3: Continuing with K, (slip st, ch 1, sc, ch 2, sc) in first corner ch-2 space, [skip next sc, sc in next sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next corner ch-2 space] 5 times, skip next sc, sc in last sc; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc and 6 corner ch-2 spaces (3 sc in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces). Fasten off.
Round 4: Draw up a loop of A in any corner ch-2 space, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in same corner ch-2 space, [skip next sc, sc in next 2 sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next corner ch-2 space] 5 times, skip next sc, sc in last 2 sc; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc and 6 corner ch-2 spaces (4 sc in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces). Fasten off.
Round 5: Draw up a loop of L in any corner ch-2 space, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in same corner ch-2 space, [skip next sc, sc in each sc to next corner ch-2 space, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next corner ch-2 space] 5 times, skip next sc, sc in each sc to end of round; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc and 6 corner ch-2 spaces (5 sc in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces).
Round 6: Continuing with L, (slip st, ch 1, sc, ch 2, sc) in first corner ch-2 space, [skip next sc, sc in each sc to next corner ch-2 space, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next corner ch-2 space] 5 times, skip next sc, sc in each sc to end of round; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc and 6 corner ch-2 spaces (6 sc in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces). Fasten off.
Round 7: With A, repeat Round 5—42 sc and 6 corner ch-2 spaces (7 sc in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces). Fasten off.
Rounds 8 and 9: With B, repeat Rounds 5 and 6—54 sc and 6 corner ch-2 spaces (9 sc in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces). Fasten off.
Round 10: With A, repeat Round 5—60 sc and 6 corner ch-2 spaces (10 sc in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces). Fasten off.
Rounds 11 and 12: With C, repeat Rounds 5 and 6—72 sc and 6 corner ch-2 spaces (12 sc in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces). Fasten off.
Round 13: With A, repeat Round 5—78 sc and 6 corner ch-2 spaces (13 sc in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces). Rounds 14 and 15: With I, repeat Rounds 5 and 6—90 sc and 6 corner ch-2 spaces (15 sc in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces). Fasten off.
Round 16: With A, repeat Round 5—96 sc and 6 corner ch-2 spaces (16 sc in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces). Fasten off.
Surface Slip Stitch Dividing Lines
Hold A on wrong side of piece, insert hook from right side to wrong side through beginning ch-4 ring, yarn over and draw up a loop; work a line of surface slip sts from beginning ch-4 ring to outer edge, as follows:
Insert hook in corner ch-2 space of next round, yarn over and draw loop through fabric and through loop on hook (one surface slip st made); repeat from * working last surface slip st in corner ch-2 space of Round 15. Work a surface slip st in each st of Round 15 to next corner ch-2 space, work a surface slip st line in corner ch-2 spaces back to beginning ch-4 ring; repeat from ** 2 more times. Fasten off.
HEXAGON II
Make same as Hexagon I, using A for Round 1, B for Rounds 2 and 3, A for Round 4, I for Rounds 5 and 6, A for Round 7, L for Rounds 8 and 9, A for Round 10, K for Rounds 11 and 12, A for Round 13, C for Rounds 14 and 15, and A for Round 16 and surface slip stitch dividing lines.
HEXAGON III
Make same as Hexagon I, using A for Round 1, L for Rounds 2 and 3, A for Round 4, C for Rounds 5 and 6, A for Round 7, I for Rounds 8 and 9, A for Round 10, B for Rounds 11 and 12, A for Round 13, K for Rounds 14 and 15, and A for Round 16 and surface slip stitch dividing lines.
HEXAGON IV
Make same as Hexagon I, using A for Round 1, G for Rounds 2 and 3, A for Round 4, J for Rounds 5 and 6, A for Round 7, F for Rounds 8 and 9, A for Round 10, E for Rounds 11 and 12, A for Round 13, H for Rounds 14 and 15, and A for Round 16 and surface slip stitch dividing lines.
HEXAGON V
Make same as Hexagon I, using A for Round 1, F for Rounds 2 and 3, A for Round 4, H for Rounds 5 and 6, A for Round 7, J for Rounds 8 and 9, A for Round 10, G for Rounds 11 and 12, A for Round 13, E for Rounds 14 and 15, and A for Round 16 and surface slip stitch dividing lines.
HEXAGON VI
Make same as Hexagon I, using A for Round 1, J for Rounds 2 and 3, A for Round 4, E for Rounds 5 and 6, A for Round 7, H for Rounds 8 and 9, A for Round 10, F for Rounds 11 and 12, A for Round 13, G for Rounds 14 and 15, and A for Round 16 and surface slip stitch dividing lines.
HEXAGON VII
Make same as Hexagon I using yarn colors and placing markers (for use later when making surface slip stitch triangles), as follows:
Round 1: Work with A. Fasten off.
Round 2: Work with B. Fasten off.
Round 3: Work with C. Fasten off.
Round 4: Work with B and place a red marker in 3rd sc following each corner ch-2 space. Fasten off.
Round 5: Work with C. Fasten off.
Round 6: Work with B. Fasten off.
Round 7: Work with C. Fasten off.
Round 8: Work with B and place a blue marker in 5th sc following each corner ch-2 space. Fasten off.
Round 9: Work with C. Fasten off.
Round 10: Work with B. Fasten off.
Round 11: Work with C and place a blue marker in 5th and 8th sc following each corner ch-2 space. Fasten off.
Round 12: Work with B. Fasten off.
Round 13: Work with C and place a red marker in 3rd and 12th sc following each corner ch-2 space. Fasten off.
Round 14: Work with B. Fasten off.
Round 15: Work with C. Fasten off.
Round 16: Work with A. Fasten off.
Surface slip stitch dividing lines: Work with A.
Surface Slip Stitch Triangles
With A, work a large surface slip stitch triangle in each section. Begin at the red marker on Round 4, work a line of surface slip sts to first red marked st on Round 13, work a line of surface slip sts to next red marked st on Round 13, then work a line of surface slip sts back to the beginning red marker. Remove red markers.
With A, work a small surface slip stitch triangle inside each large triangle. Begin at the blue marker on Round 8, work a line of surface slip sts to blue marked st on Round 11, work a line of surface slip sts to next blue marked st on Round 11, then work a line of surface slip sts back to the beginning blue marker. Remove blue markers.
HEXAGON VIII
Make same as Hexagon VII, using A for Round 1, [D for next round, E for next round] 7 times, and A for Round 16, surface slip st dividing lines and triangles.
HEXAGON IX
Make same as Hexagon VII, using A for Round 1, [F for next round, G for next round] 7 times, and A for Round 16, surface slip st dividing lines and triangles.
HEXAGON X
Make same as Hexagon VII, using A for Round 1, [H for next round, I for next round] 7 times, and A for Round 16, surface slip st dividing lines and triangles.
HEXAGON XI
Make same as Hexagon VII, using A for Round 1, [J for next round, K for next round] 7 times, and A for Round 16, surface slip st dividing lines and triangles.
HEXAGON XII
Make same as Hexagon VII, using A for Round 1, [G for next round, L for next round] 7 times, and A for Round 16, surface slip st dividing lines and triangles.
HEXAGON XIII
Work Rounds 1–6 same as Rounds 1–6 of Hexagon I using yarn colors and placing markers (for use later when making long-sc sts and surface slip st diamond lines) as follows:
Round 1: Work with A. Fasten off.
Rounds 2 and 3: Work with I. Do not fasten off.
Round 4: Continue with I and place a marker in 3rd sc following each corner ch-2 space. Do not fasten off.
Rounds 5 and 6: Continue with I. Fasten off.
Round 7: Draw up a loop of A in any corner ch-2 space, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in same corner ch-2 space, [ch 1, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc of Round 6, long sc in marked st of Round 4 and remove marker, push long sc back toward last sc made, sc in next sc of Round 6 (do not skip a sc between the 2 sc of Round 6 worked before and after the long-sc), ch 1, skip next 2 sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next corner ch-2 space] 5 times, ch 1, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc of Round 6, long sc in marked st of Round 4, push long sc toward last sc made, sc in next sc of Round 6, ch 1, skip last 2 sc; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc, 6 long-sc, 12 ch-1 spaces, and 6 corner ch-2 spaces (4 sc, 1 long-sc, and 2 ch-1 spaces in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces). Fasten off.
Round 8: Draw up a loop of J in any corner ch-2 space, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in same corner ch-2 space, [skip next sc, 3 sc in next ch-1 space, skip next 3 sts, 3 sc in next ch-1 space, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next corner ch-2 space] 5 times, skip next sc, 3 sc in next ch-1 space, skip next 3 sts, 3 sc in next ch-1 space; join with slip st in first sc—48 sc and 6 corner ch-2 spaces (8 sc in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces). Do not fasten off.
Work Rounds 9–14 same as Rounds 9–14 of Hexagon I using yarn colors and placing markers.
Round 9: Continue with J.
Round 10: Continue with J and place a marker in 5th sc following each corner ch-2 space. Fasten off.
Round 11: Work with A. Fasten off.
Round 12: Work with G and place a marker in 2nd sc following each corner ch-2 space. Do not fasten off.
Rounds 13 and 14: Continue with G.
Round 15: Draw up a loop of A in any corner ch-2 space, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in same corner ch-2 space, *skip next sc, sc in next sc of Round 15, long-sc in marked sc of Round 12 and remove marker, [skip next sc of Round 15 (under the long-sc), sc in next sc of Round 15, skip next sc of Round 12, long-sc in next sc of Round 12] 5 times, skip next sc of Round 15 (under the long-sc), sc in next sc of Round 15 **, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next corner ch-2 space; repeat from * around ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in first sc—54 sc, 36 long-sc and 6 corner ch-2 spaces (9 sc and 6 long-sc in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces). Do not fasten off.
Round 16: With A, work Round 6 of Hexagon I—96 sc and 6 ch-2 spaces (16 sc in each of 6 sections between corner ch-2 spaces). Fasten off.
Surface slip stitch dividing lines: Work with A.
Surface Slip Stitch Diamond Lines
With A, begin at any corner ch-2 space of Round 7, work a line of surface slip sts to marked st on Round 10, work a line of surface slip sts to next corner ch-2 space of Round 7; repeat around. Remove markers.
HEXAGON XIV
Make same as Hexagon XIII using A for Round 1, G for Rounds 2–6, A for Round 7, I for Rounds 8–10, A for Round 11, J for Rounds 12–14, and A for Rounds 15 and 16 and surface slip stitch dividing lines and diamond lines.
HEXAGON XV
Make same as Hexagon XIII using A for Round 1, J for Rounds 2–6, A for Round 7, G for Rounds 8–10, A for Round 11, I for Rounds 12–14, and A for Rounds 15 and 16 and surface slip stitch dividing lines and diamond lines.
HEXAGON XVI
Make same as Hexagon XIII using A for Round 1, D for Rounds 2–6, A for Round 7, F for Rounds 8–10, A for Round 11, H for Rounds 12–14, and A for Rounds 15 and 16 and surface slip stitch dividing lines and diamond lines.
HEXAGON XVII
Make same as Hexagon XIII using A for Round 1, H for Rounds 2–6, A for Round 7, D for Rounds 8–10, A for Round 11, F for Rounds 12–14, and A for Rounds 15 and 16 and surface slip stitch dividing lines and diamond lines.
HEXAGON XVIII
Make same as Hexagon XIII using A for Round 1, F for Rounds 2–6, A for Round 7, H for Rounds 8–10, A for Round 11, D for Rounds 12–14, and A for Rounds 15 and 16 and surface slip stitch dividing lines and diamond lines.
HEXAGON XIX
Make same as Hexagon I using yarn colors and placing markers (for use later when making surface slip stitch curving lines), as follows:
Round 1: Work with A. Fasten off.
Rounds 2–14: Work with B. Do not fasten off.
Round 15: Continue with B and place a marker in 4th, 7th, 10th, and 13th sc following each corner ch-2 space. Fasten off.
Round 16: Work with A.
Surface slip stitch dividing lines: Work with A.
Surface Slip Stitch Curving Lines
With A, work curving lines in each of the 6 sections. Begin in any corner ch-2 space of Round 3, working from left to right across section, work a slightly curving line of surface slip sts to first marked st of Round 15. Fasten off. Make three more curving lines of surface slip sts, working one line between corner ch-2 space of Round 6 and 2nd marked st of Round 15, another line between corner ch-2 space of Round 9 and 3rd marked st of Round 15, and final curving line between corner ch-2 space of Round 12 and 4th marked st or Round 15.
FINISHING
With right side facing and A, following Assembly Diagram, sew Hexagons together.
EDGING
With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in back loop of any st.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in back loop of each sc and ch around, working 1 sc in each space between two Hexagons (if needed to keep work flat); working in both loops, join with slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Slip st in base of same st as joining, *slip st in next st, slip st in base of same st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first st.
Weave in ends.

pattern_name: HIP TO BE SQUARE CROCHET BABY BLANKET
materials: Bernat® Baby Velvet™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 492 yds/450 m)
Main Color (MC) Cuddly Cloud (86018) 1 ball
Contrast A Bunny Brown (86028) 1 ball
Contrast B Indigo Velvet (86035) 1 ball
Contrast C Restful Rose (86002) 1 ball
Contrast D Ivy (86031) 1 ball
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Stitch marker.
Yarn needle.
abbreviations: Sc3tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 3 chains or stitches. Yoh and draw through all 4 loops on hook
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Motifs are joined as you crochet. After completing Motif 1, work along adjoining Motifs to join as you work as shown in diagram.
BLANKET
First Strip
Motif I: With A, ch 36.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 15 ch. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of last 16 ch. Turn. 33 sts.
**2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 15 sc. Sc3tog – PM on last st for center. 1 sc in each of last 15 sc. Turn. 31 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to 3 center sts. Sc3tog - PM on last st for center. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until 3 sts rem.
Next row:  Ch 1. Sc3tog. Fasten off.**

Motifs II to VII: (RS). With appropriate color (see diagram), join yarn with sl st to bottom left corner of previous Motif. Ch 19. Turn.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 15 ch. Sc3tog over next 2 ch and sp along side edge of previous Motif. Work 16 sc up along side of previous Motif. 33 sts.
Rep from ** to ** as given for Motif I.

Second Strip
Motif I: (RS). With appropriate color (see diagram), join yarn with sl st to top right corner of first Motif from previous strip. Ch 19.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 15 ch. Sc3tog over next 2 ch and sp along top edge of Motif I from previous Strip. Work 16 sc across top edge of Motif from previous Strip. Turn. 33 sts.
Rep from ** to ** as given for Motif I of First Strip.

Motifs II to VII: (RS). With appropriate color (see diagram), join yarn with sl st to top left corner of Motif from previous Strip. Turn.
1st row: (WS). Ch 1. Work 16 sc across top edge of Motif from previous Strip. Sc3tog over Motif from previous strip and previous Motif from same strip. Work 16 sc up side edge of Motif from same strip. Turn. 33 sts.
Rep from ** to ** as given for Motif I of First Strip.
With appropriate colors (see diagram), rep Second Strip until 7 Strips in total have been made.

FINISHING
Edging: 1st rnd: (RS). Join MC with sl st to any corner of Blanket. Ch 1. Work sc evenly around Blanket, working (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd to 7th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around working (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in each corner ch-2 sp. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 2 skeins each of 320 Cornmeal A and 624 Tea Leaf B; 1 skein each of 706 Perfect Pink C, 718 Shocking Pink D, and 254 Pumpkin E.
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 5.0mm [US H-8] or size needed for gauge
Yarn needle.
abbreviations: A, B, C, D, E = color A, B, C, D, E
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Throw Measures: 48” (122 cm) wide x 53” (134.5 cm)
gauge: 1 pattern repeat, 18 sts = 6” (15 cm); 6 rows = 4¼” (11 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
THROW
With A, ch 147. Row 1 (right side): Dc in 4th ch from hook, *dc in each of next 6 ch, skip next ch, dc in each of next 2 ch, skip next ch, dc in each of next 6 ch**, 2 dc in each of next 2 ch; repeat from * across ending last repeat at **, 2 dc in last ch, turn—8 pattern repeats.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc, here and throughout), dc in first st, *dc in each of next 6 dc, skip next dc, BPdc around each of next 2 dc, skip next dc, dc in each of next 6 dc**, 2 dc in each of next 2 dc; repeat from * across, ending last repeat at **, 2 dc in last dc, turn. Fasten off.
Row 3: With right side facing, join B with a slip st in first st, ch 3, dc in first st, *dc in each of next 6 dc, skip next dc, FPdc around each of next 2 dc, skip next dc, dc in each of next 6 dc**, 2 dc in each of next 2 dc; repeat from * across, ending last repeat at **, 2 dc in last st, turn.
Rows 4: Repeat Row 2.
Row 5: With right side facing, join C with a slip st in first st, ch 3, dc in first st, *dc in each of next 6 dc, skip next dc, FPdc around each of next 2 dc, ch 1 (slip st, [ch 5, slip st] 3 times) around last FPdc worked, ch 5, (slip st, [ch 5, slip st] 3 times) around previously worked FPdc (flower completed), skip next dc, dc in each of next 6 dc**, 2 dc in each of next 2 dc; repeat from * across, ending last repeat at **, 2 dc in last st, turn.
Row 6: Ch 3, dc in first st, *dc in each of next 6 dc, skip next dc, 2 dc in center of flower, skip next dc, dc in each of next 6 dc**, 2 dc in each of next 2 dc; repeat from * across, ending last repeat at**, 2 dc in last st, turn. Fasten off.
Row 7: Join A with a slip st in first st, ch 3, dc in first st, *dc in each of next 6 dc, skip next dc, FPdc around each of next 2 dc, skip next dc, dc in each of next 6 dc**, 2 dc in each of next 2 dc; repeat from * across, ending last repeat at**, 2 dc in last st, turn.
Rows 8–74: Maintaining color sequence as established, repeat Rows 2–7 for pattern ending with Row 2 and A. Do not fasten off.
EDGING
Working across top edge with A, ch 1, (sc, ch 3, sc) in first st, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next st,[skip next st, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next st] twice, *skip next 2 sts, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next st, skip next 2 sts, [(sc, ch 3, sc) in next st, skip next st] 6 times, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next st; repeat from * 7 times, skip next 2 sts, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next post st, skip next 2 sts, [(sc, ch 3, sc) in next st, skip next st] 3 times, (sc, ch 3, sc) in last st, working across side edge of Throw, (sc, ch 3, sc) in each row-end dc across, working across opposite side of foundation ch, (sc, ch 3, sc) in first ch, [skip next ch, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch] 3 times, *[skip next 2 ch, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch] twice, [skip next ch, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch] 6 times; repeat from * across, ending last repeat at **, skip next 2 ch, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch, [skip next ch, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch] 4 times, (sc, ch 3, sc) in last ch, working across side edge, (sc, ch 3, sc) in each row-end dc across; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

Contrast A Teddy Brown (96016) 3 balls

instructions:
1st Block (See diagram on page 2).

Rep 2nd row until work from joining row measures approx 6" [15 cm], ending on a WS row. Fasten off. Join C with sl st to first st of last row.

Turn work 90 degrees clockwise. 1st row: (RS). With C, ch 2. Work 68 hdc evenly across side edges of 8th Block, 5th Block and 6th Block. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from joining row measures approx 6" [15 cm], ending on a WS row. Fasten off. Join D with sl st to first st of last row.

Rep 2nd row until work from joining row measures approx 6" [15 cm], ending on a WS row. Fasten off. Join B with sl st to first st of last row.

Rep 2nd row until work from joining row measures approx 6" [15 cm], ending on a WS row. Fasten off. Join A with sl st to first st of last row.

instructions:
BLANKET
With MC, ch 66. 
1st row: (RS). Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in each of next 4 ch. *1 hdc in each of next 5 ch. Sl st in each of next 5 ch. Rep from * 4 times more. Turn.
2nd row:  Working in back loops only, sl st in each of next 5 sl st. *1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Sl st in each of next 5 sl st. Rep from * 4 times more. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2 (does not count as hdc). Working in back loops only, 1 hdc in each of next 5 sl st. *Sl st in each of next 5 hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 sl st. Rep from * 4 times more. Turn.

Rep last 4 rows until work from beg measures 50" [127 cm], ending with a 2nd or 4th row. Fasten off.

EDGING
With RS facing, join A with sl st at top right corner of Blanket.
1st rnd:  Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st (corner). Work 53 sc evenly across top edge. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next st (corner). Work 73 sc evenly down side. (1 sc. Cable Pattern
Row 4 (right side): Ch 1, sc in first sc, *ch 3, skip next 2 sc of previous row (Row 3), sc in next sc, TURN, work sc in each ch of the ch-3 just made, slip st in the sc that was made just before the ch-3 was made (cable made), TURN; working behind the cable, sc in each of the skipped sc; repeat from * across to last sc, sc in last sc, turn—11 cables.
Note: In the next row, you will work a sc in the first and last sc, and 3 sc evenly spaced behind each cable (on wrong side). The 3 sc behind each cable are worked into the stitches that were worked into the 2 skipped sc. Work 2 sc in the first of these stitches and 1 sc in the other. Do not work into the sc of the cables. Push the cables towards the right side of the Throw as you work.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *working in the 2 sts “behind” the next cable, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * across to last st, sc in last st, turn—35 sc.
Low Front Ridge
Rows 6 and 7: Repeat Rows 2 and 3.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, do NOT turn.
Reverse Single Crochet Ridge
Note: Both rows of the Reverse Single Crochet Ridge are worked into the stitches of the previous row. The first row (Row 9) is worked into the front loops only. The next row (Row 10) is worked into the free loops of the same row.
Row 9: Working in front loops only, ch 1, skip the first sc, reverse sc in each sc across, slip st in turning ch, do NOT turn.
Row 10: Working in remaining back loops of Row 8, sc in first sc and each sc across, turn.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Throw measures 50 x 70” (127 x 178 cm)
Pillow measures 12 x 12” (30.5 x 30.5 cm)
Special Stitches
picot = Ch 3, slip st in 3rd ch from hook.
reverse sc (reverse single crochet) = Work single crochet in opposite direction from which you would usually work (left to right if you are right-handed, and right to left if you are left-handed). This stitch is also known as crab stitch. It creates a rope-like twisted single crochet ridge.
Notes
1. Throw is made from 20 Squares. Squares are arranged as shown in assembly diagram and crocheted together.
2. Pillow is made from 2 Squares.
THROW
SQUARE (make 20)
With larger hook and A, ch 36.
Row 1 (wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—35 sc.
Low Front Ridge
Note: Both rows of the Low Front Ridge are worked into the stitches of the previous row. The first row (Row 2) is worked into the front loops only. The piece is then turned and the next row (Row 3) is worked into the free loops of the same row (the free loops are in the front after the piece is turned).
Row 2 (right side): Ch 1, working in front loops only, skip the first sc, slip st in next sc and in each sc across, slip st in turning ch, turn—35 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, working in the free loops of sts in same row as Row 2 was worked, do not skip first sc, sc in each sc across (do not work in the turning ch), turn—35 sc.
Rows 12 and 13: Work same as Rows 2 and 3.
Cable Pattern
Rows 14 and 15: Work same as Rows 4 and 5.
Shadow Box
Row 18: Ch 2 (does not count as a st), dc in first 4 sts, *skip next 2 sts, tr in next 2 sts, working behind the last 2 sts made, tr in each of the 2 skipped sts, skip next 2 sts, tr in next 2 sts, working in front of the last 2 sts made, tr in each of the 2 skipped sts, dc in next 2 sts; repeat from * 2 more times, dc in last st, turn.

Rows 20 and 21: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Rows 22–37: Repeat Rows 2–17.

Change to smaller hook.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, (sc, ch 1, sc) in first sc (first corner made), sc in each st across to last st, (sc, ch 1, sc) in last st (corner made); working in ends of rows, work 33 sc evenly spaced across side edge; working across opposite side of foundation ch, (sc, ch 1, sc) in first ch (corner made), sc in next 33 ch,  (sc, ch 1, sc) in last ch (corner made); working in ends of rows, work 33 sc evenly spaced across side edge; join with slip st in first sc—140 sc (35 sc across each side of square) and 4 corner ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
Assembly
Arrange Squares as shown in Assembly Diagram. Crochet edges of five Squares together to make a strip, crocheting neighboring edges of Squares together as follows.
1. Hold 2 Squares with wrong sides together (right sides facing out) and stitches of edge to be joined matching.
2. With smaller hook and working through both thicknesses, draw up a loop of yarn in corner at beginning of edge to be joined, work reverse sc all the way across edge to join Squares. Fasten off.
3. Repeat to make 4 strips. Crochet long edges of strips together in same manner to form Throw.
Throw Border
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing and smaller hook, join yarn with sc in a corner ch-1 space to work across a short edge, sc in each sc and join between Squares across short edge, (sc, ch 1, sc) in corner ch-1 space, sc in each sc and join between Squares across long edge, (sc, ch 1, sc) in corner ch-1 space, sc in each sc and join between Squares across next short edge, (sc, ch 1, sc) in corner ch-1 space, sc in each sc and join between Squares across next long edge, sc in same corner ch-1 space as first sc, ch 1; join with slip st in first sc, do NOT turn—652 sc (145 sc across each short edge, and 181 sc across each long edge) and 4 corner ch-1 spaces.
Round 2: Ch 1, reverse sc in each sc across long edge to corner ch-1 space, TURN (so wrong side is facing), slip st in corner ch-1 space, ch 1, sc in each sc across short edge to next corner ch-1 space, sc in corner ch-1 space, ch 1, TURN (so right side is facing), reverse sc in each sc across next long edge to next corner ch-1 space, TURN (so wrong side is facing), slip st in corner ch-1 space, ch 1, sc in each sc across short edge to beginning ch-1, sc in beginning ch-1, turn—656 sc (146 sc across each short edge and 182 sc across each long edge). Do not fasten off.

Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each dc and ch-1 space across, turn—147 sc.
Low Front Ridge
Row 3: Ch 1, working in front loops only, skip the first sc, slip st in next sc and in each sc across, slip st in turning ch, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, working in the free loops of sts in same row as Row 3 were worked, do not skip first sc, sc in each sc across (do not work in the turning ch), turn.
Cable Pattern
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, *ch 3, skip next 2 sc of Row 4, sc in next sc, TURN, work sc in each ch of the ch-3 just made, slip st in the sc that was made just before the ch-3 was made (cable made), TURN; working behind the cable, sc in each of the skipped sc; repeat from * across to last sc, sc in last sc, sc in turning ch, turn—48 cables.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, *working in the 2 sts “behind” the cable, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * across, sc in last st, sc in turning ch, turn—148 sc.
Low Front Ridge
Row 7: Ch 1, working in front loops only, skip the first sc, slip st in next sc and in each sc across, slip st in turning ch, turn.
Row 8: Ch 1, working in the free loops of sts in same row as Row 7 were worked, do not skip first sc, sc in each sc across (do not work in the turning ch), turn.
Dc-Mesh
Row 9: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), skip first st, dc in next st, *ch 1, skip next st, dc in next st; repeat from * across, turn—75 dc and 74 ch-1 spaces.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in first dc, sc in next ch-1 space, sc in next dc, *skip next ch-1 space, skip next dc, skip next ch-1 space, (4 tr, picot, 4 tr) in next dc, skip next ch-1 space, skip next dc, skip next ch-1 space, sc in next dc; repeat from * across to turning ch-space, sc in turning ch-space, sc in 3rd ch of turning ch—18 (4 tr, picot, 4 tr) groups.
Fasten off.
FINISHING THROW
Weave in any remaining ends.
PILLOW 
(make 3 – 1 each with A, B, and C)
SQUARES 
(make 2 for each pillow)
Make same as Squares for Throw, including Border.
SLIP COVER (optional)
Note: Because color of pillow will show through the stitches in the center, designer recommends sewing a simple slip cover in a similar color for the pillow form before covering with the crocheted squares.
Cut 2 pieces of fabric, 12½ x 12½” (32 x 32 cm). Hold the pieces with right sides together. Leaving a ¼” (6 mm) seam allowance, sew 3 sides of fabric squares together. Turn the piece right side out, insert pillow form. Pin the 4th side closed, tucking ¼” (6 mm) seam allowance to the inside and sew closed.
FINISHING PILLOW
Hold the 2 crocheted Squares with wrong sides together (right sides facing outward). With smaller hook, matching yarn color, and working through both thicknesses, draw up a loop of yarn in any corner, ch 1, work reverse sc all the way across 3 sides to join Squares. Insert pillow form and crochet last side closed, join with slip st in beginning ch-1. Fasten off. Weave in any remaining ends.

Contrast C Berry (00607) 1 ball
Contrast D Black (07421) 1 ball
Bernat® Pipsqueak™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 254 yds/232 m)
Contrast E Whitey White (58005) 1 ball
Size U.S. H/8 [5 mm] crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: Bernat® Super Value™ :  13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm]. Bernat® Pipsqueak™ :  13 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Blanket
With A, ch 101.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 100 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 30" [76 cm], ending on a WS row. Break A. Join E. Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 40" [101.5 cm]. Fasten off.
Border
With RS facing, join B with sl st to upper right corner. 
1st rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to corner. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in corner. Work 130 sc evenly down long edge of Blanket to corner. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in corner. 1 sc in each sc to corner. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in corner. Work 130 sc evenly up long edge of blanket to corner. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in corner. Join with sl st to first sc.

Body of Snowplow 
With C, ch 34.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 33 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row:  Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 32 sts.
4th row: As 2nd row. 
5th row: As 3rd row. 31 sts.
6th row: As 2nd row. 
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 dc in each of next 3 sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. Turn. 
8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. Turn. 
9th row: As 3rd row.  11 sts.
10th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 11 sts. Turn.
11th row: As 3rd row. 10 sts.
12th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. Turn.
13th row: As 3rd row. 9 sts.
14th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. Turn.
15th row: As 14th row. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. 
Snowplow Pusher
With B, ch 7.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 6 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
3rd row:  As 2nd row. 
4th row:  Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 6 sc.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
6th to 9th rows: Rep 4th and 5th rows twice more.
10th to 13th rows: As 5th row.
14th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 6 sc.
15th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
16th to 19th rows: Rep 14th and 15th rows twice more.
20th to 22nd rows: As 15th row. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. 
Snowplow Window
With B, ch 7.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 6 sc.  
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. Turn. 5 sc.
4th row: As 2nd row. 
5th row: As 3rd row. 4 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. 
Wheels (make 2)
With B, begin using magic loop method, demonstrated here.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in magic loop. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Break B. Join D. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
6th rnd: As 3rd rnd. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Wheel Arch
With B, ch 35. 
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 34 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of ch. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. *1 hdc in next sc. 1 dc in next sc. 1 tr in next sc. 2 tr in each of next 3 sc. 1 tr in next sc. 1 dc in next sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 9 sts. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 8 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. 
Snowballs (make 6) 
With E, begin using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 2. 10 dc in magic loop. Join with sl st to first dc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.

FINISHING
Note: Long tails left when fastening off may be used to sew Snowplow components and Snowballs to Blanket. Sew Body of Snowplow to Blanket, approx. 8" [20.5 cm] from left edge, and 3" [7.5 cm] above beg of section worked in E, as pictured. Sew Wheel Arch as pictured, followed by Snowplow Pusher and Wheels. Add Snowballs to back of Snowplow Body and in front of Snowplow Pusher. With tapestry needle, cross stitch strands of E to Blanket to create snowflakes, working each cross stitch 3 times.

instructions:
Notes:
• Ch 2 at beg of rows does not count as st.
• To change colors, work to last 2 loops on hook. Drop previous color from hook, draw new color through and proceed.
• Carry color not in use loosely up side of work.
Stripe Pat
Work 2 rows A.
Work 2 rows B. 
These 4 rows form Stripe Pat.
With A, ch 146 (multiple of 16 ch + 2). See diagram on page 2.
Foundation Row: (WS). Working into horizontal “bump” at back of each ch, 2 dc in 3rd ch from hook. *1 dc in each of next 7 ch. Skip next ch. 1 dc in each of next 7 ch. 3 dc in next ch. Rep from * to last 16 ch. 1 dc in each of next 7 ch. Skip next ch. 1 dc in each of next 7 ch. 2 dc in last ch. Turn.
1st row: Ch 2. 2 dc in first dc. *1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Skip next 2 dc. 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. 3 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 17 dc. 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Skip next 2 dc. 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. 2 dc in last dc. Turn.
First 2 rows of Stripe Pat are complete.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last row for pat until work from beg measures approx 60" [152.5 cm], ending with 2 rows of A. Do not fasten off at end of last row. Break B. Do not turn at end of last row.
FINISHING
Side edging: With A and RS facing, cont as follows: Ch 1. Work 1 row of sc evenly down side edge of Blanket. Fasten off.
With RS facing, join A with sl st to bottom right corner of Blanket. Ch 1. Work 1 row of sc evenly up side of Blanket. Fasten off.
Fringe: Cut lengths of B 10" [25.5 cm] long. Taking 6 strands tog, knot into fringe evenly across top and bottom of Blanket. Trim fringe evenly.
Fringe
Fringe: Cut yarn 10 to 14 ins [25.5 to 35.5 cm] long. Taking 2 or 3 strands together for each fringe knot into fringe across cast on and cast off edges. Trim fringe evenly.

instructions:
Mother: Dark gray fur is Color 1. Light gray is Color 2. Pink is Color 3. Black is Color 4.
Baby: Same numbers apply. You don’t need any Color 2.
Notes: 
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed.
• Do not join at end of rnd. Work in continuous rnds (spiral). Move marker up as each rnd is completed.
MOTHER
Head
Beg at top of head with smaller hook and Color 2, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd:  *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. (18 sc).
4th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
6th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
7th to 11th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around.
12th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 24 sts.
13th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Insert safety eyes between 9th and 10th rnds 7 sts apart. With Color 4 embroider a triangle satin st for nose, making a long st along each of the 3 sides to shape. (See Diagram on page 3.)
14th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 18 sts.
15th rnd: *1 sc in next sc. Sc 2tog. Rep from * around. 12 sts. Stuff head.
16th rnd:  *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw yarn through rem sts. Pull tightly, fasten securely, leaving a long end of yarn.
Body 
With smaller hook and Color 2, ch 2.
1st to 11th rnds: Work as given for Head. 30 sc.
12th to 14th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
15th to 19th rnds: Work as given for Head for rnds 12 to 16.
Sew Head to Body.
Leg: (make 2) 
With smaller hook and Color 2, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  2 sc in each sc around. (12sc).
3rd rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. (15 sc).
4th to 8th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving a long for sewing. Stuff Legs and sew in place. With Color 4 embroider 3 little straight sts on each leg for claws. (See Diagram on page 3.)
Arm (make 2) 
With smaller hook and Color 2, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd to 6th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving a long for sewing. Stuff Arms. Sew in place. With Color 4 embroider 3 little straight sts on each arm for claws.
Ear (make 2) 
With larger hook and Color 1, ch 3.
1st row: 9 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Turn. 9 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 sc in next hdc. Rep from * to end of row. Fasten off. (12 sc).
Inner Ear (make 2) 
With smaller hook and Color 3, ch 2
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  2 sc in each sc around. (12 sc).
3rd rnd:  *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. Sew in place to outer ear. 
BABY 
Body
With larger hook and Color 1, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  2 sc in each sc around. (12 sc).
3rd to 6th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Stuff lightly. Thread yarn through rem sts and gather slightly.
Head
With larger hook and Color 1, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. (9 sc).
3rd and 4th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Stuff lightly. Thread yarn through rem sts and gather neck slightly. 
Sew Head to Body.
Leg (Make 4) 
With larger hook and Color 1, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Stuff lightly. Thread yarn through rem sts and gather slightly. Sew in place.

Large Body

Round 5: [2 sc in same sc, 4 sc] around (36 sts).
Round 6: [2 sc in same sc, 5 sc] around (42 sts).
Round 7: [2 sc in same sc, 6 sc] around (48 sts).
Round 8: [2 sc in same sc, 7 sc] around (54 sts).
Round 9: [2 sc in same sc, 8 sc] around (60 sts).
Round 10: [2 sc in same sc, 9 sc] around (66 sts).
Round 11: [2 sc in same sc, 10 sc] around (72 sts).
Round 12: [2 sc in same sc, 11 sc] around, changing to B in last st (78 sts).
Round 13: [2 sc in same sc, 12 sc] around (84 sts).
Round 14: [13 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around (90 sts).
Round 15: [14 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around (96 sts).
Round 16: [15 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around, changing to E in last st (102 sts).
Rounds 17-19: Sc in each sc around, changing to A in last st of last round.
Round 20: Sc in each sc around. 
Round 21: [Sc2tog, sc in next 15 sc] around, changing to C in last stitch (96 sts).
Round 22: [Sc in next 14 sc, sc2tog] around (90 sts).
Rounds 23-25: Sc in each sc around, changing to B in last st of last round (90 sts).
Round 26: [13 sc, sc2tog] around (84 sts).
Rounds 27-37: Sc in each sc around, in the following stripe pattern: B 1 round; E 7 rounds; B 2 rounds; C 1 round
Round 38: [12 sc, sc2tog] around (78 sts).
Rounds 39-44: Sc in each sc around, in the following stripe pattern: C 1 round; B 3 rounds; E 2 rounds, decreasing 6 sts evenly in last round (72 sts).
Round 45: [7 sc, sc2tog] around (64 sts).
Round 46: [6 sc, sc2tog] around (56 sts).
Round 47: [2 sc, sc2tog] around (42 sts).
Round 48: [5 sc, sc2tog] around (36 sts).
Set aside and begin arms.
Small Body
Work through Round 12 as for Large Body, changing to B at end of Round 11.
Round 13: Sc in each sc around, changing to C in last st (78 sts). 
Round 14: [Sc2tog, 11 sc] around (72 sts).
Round 15: [Sc2tog, 10 sc] around, changing to E in last st (66 sts).
Rounds 16-18: Sc in each sc around.
Round 19: [9 sc, sc2tog] around, changing to A in last st (60 sts).
Rounds 20-29: Sc in each sc around in the following stripe pattern: A 2 rounds; B 2 rounds; C 1 round; E 1 round
Round 30: [8 sc, sc2tog] around (54 sts).
Rounds 31-32: Sc in each sc around.
Round 33: [7 sc, sc2tog] around (48 sts).
Round 34: [6 sc, sc2tog] around, changing to A in last st (42 sts).
Round 35: [Sc2tog, 5 sc] around (36 sts).
Round 36: [Sc2tog, 4 sc] around (30 sts).
Set aside and begin arms.
Large Arms (make 2)
With E held double and larger hook, ch 12 and join with a slip st in a ring. 
Rounds 1-4: Sc in each ch around changing to A in last st of last round (12 sts).
Round 5: [2 sc in same sc, sc] around (18 sts).
Round 6: Sc around changing to B in last st.
Rounds 7-20: Sc in each sc around in the following pattern: B 3 rounds; C 1 round; E 4 rounds; A 3 rounds; B 2 rounds; C 1 round, changing to E at the end of round.
Round 21: Ch 1, slip st in each st around, fasten off (18 sts).
Hands
Round 22: Change to smaller hook. Locate last round of sc before slip st round, join a single strand of D in any st, ch 1, 2 sc in each st around (36 sts).
Round 23: [2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around (48 sts). Rounds 24-30:  Sc in each sc around.
Round 31: [Sc2tog, 2 sc] around (36 sts).
Round 32: [Sc2tog, 2 sc] around (27 sts).
Round 33: [Sc2tog, sc] around (18 sts).
Round 34: [Sc2tog] around (9 sts).
Round 35: [Sc2tog] to last st, sc (5 sts). Fasten off.
Repeat for other arm. Stuff arms. Locate arm placement and pin arms in place at neck opening. Slip st arms to neck opening, closing top of arm. Proceed to head instructions.
Small Arms (make 2)
With E held double and larger hook, work as for large arms through Round 4, changing to A at end of last round (12 sts).
Rounds 5-13: Sc in each sc around in the following pattern: A 2 rounds; B 1 round; C 2 rounds; E 4 rounds
Round 14: Ch 1, slip st in each st around, fasten off (12 sts).
Hands
Round 15: Change to smaller hook. Locate last round of sc before slip st round, join a single strand of D in any st, ch 1, 2 sc in each st around (24 sts).
Round 16: [2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around (32 sts).
Rounds 17-19: Sc in each sc around.
Round 20: [Sc2tog, 2 sc] around (24 sts). 
Round 21: [Sc2tog, 2 sc] around (18 sts). 
Round 22: [Sc2tog, sc] around (12 sts). 
Round 23: [Sc2tog] around (6 sts).
Fasten off, using yarn tail to weave hole closed.
Attach to body as for large arms.
Head
Round 1: Locate last round of sc before slip st round at neck opening of body. Using smaller hook and single strand of D, join yarn in any st. 2 sc in each st around [72 (60) sts].
Round 2: [2 sc in same sc, 2 sc] around [96 (80) sts].
Round 3: [2 sc in same sc, 3 sc] around [120 (100) sts].
Sc in each sc around for 25 (12) rounds.
Next round: [Sc2tog, 3 sc] around [96 (80) sts].
Next round: Sc in each sc around.
Next round: [Sc2tog, 2 sc] around [72 (60) sts].
Sc in each sc around for 4 (2) rounds.
Antennae
Lay piece face upwards and flatten head, making certain to smooth the layers. Locate the sts on the rightmost edge. Count 10 sts in from the edge and place marker. Likewise, count in 10 sts on back layer so that there are 20 sts between the markers (wrapping around the side of the head). Repeat for the left antenna. Sc in each of the 20 sts around for 12 (3) rounds.
Next round: [Sc, 2 sc in next sc] around (30 sts).
Next round: Sc in each sc around.
Next round: [4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around (36 sts). 
Next round: [5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around (42 sts).
Next round: Sc in each sc around.
Next round: [5 sc, sc2tog] around (36 sts).
Next round: [4 sc, sc2tog] around (30 sts).
Next round: [3 sc, sc2tog] around (24 sts).
Next round: [2 sc, sc2tog] around (18 sts).
Next round: [Sc2tog] around (9 sts).
Next round: [Sc2tog] around to last st, sc (5 sts).
Fasten off, weaving yarn tail through sts to close hole. Repeat for other antenna.
FINISHING 
Embellish face before stuffing toy as follows: 
Using a lid from a small jar or other small round shape, trace out 2 circles onto felt for eyes. Cut out, pin onto face in desired location and attach using embroidery floss and a whipstitch.
If using buttons, attach with strong thread, making certain to knot the thread securely. Experiment with button placement, which can change the expression of the toy. Embroider the mouth with a running or outline stitch. Likewise, make small upward slanting dashes for eyebrows. 
Stuff toy firmly, making certain to smooth out lumps. Using long tail from antenna, sew top of head closed, knotting securely. Weave in ends.

abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.

instructions:
Note: All rnds are joined with a sl st to first st. Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
Feet (make 2)
With A, beg using magic loop method, demonstrated here.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 dc in each of next 2 sts. 2 hdc in each of next 2 sts. 2 sc in each of next 2 sts. Join. 12 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 24 sts.
4th and 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 5 times. 1 sc in each of the last 14 sts. Join. 19 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
8th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each of last 13 sts. Join. 16 sts.
9th to 12th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. Fasten off at end of last rnd.
Arms (make 2)
With A, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 12 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sts.
4th to 6th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 15 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
10th to 17th rnds: As 8th rnd. Fasten off.
Spikes (make 6)
With B, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 4 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st) twice. Join. 6 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts) twice. Join. 8 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts) twice. Join. 10 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts) twice. Join. 12 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts) twice. Join. 14 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts) twice. Join. 16 sts. Fasten off.
Tail
With A, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 4 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 6 sts.
3rd and alt rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 8 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 10 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sts.
10th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 14 sts.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 16 sts.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sts.
16th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sts.
18th rnd: As 6th rnd. 25 sts.
20th rnd: As 8th rnd. 30 sts.
22nd rnd: As 4th rnd.
23rd rnd: As 3rd rnd. Fasten off.
Body
With A, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 20 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sts.
7th rnd: As 4th rnd.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sts.
9th to 13th rnds: As 4th rnd.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sts.
15th to 18th rnds: As 4th rnd.
19th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sts.
20th to 22nd rnd: As 4th rnd.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
24th to 29th rnds: As 4th rnd.
30th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sts.
31st to 34th rnds: As 4th rnd. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff body, leaving top open.
Head
With A, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 20 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sts.
8th to 11th rnds: As 3rd rnd.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sts.
13th to 15th rnds: As 3rd rnd.
16th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
17th to 24th rnds: As 3rd rnd.
Note: Safety eyes should be placed between 13th and 14th rnd, and should be spaced 10 sts apart as shown in photo. Begin stuffing Head as you work.
25th rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sts.
26th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
27th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 10 sts.
28th rnd: As 27th rnd. 5 sc.
Finishing
Stuff Arms and Spikes, and sew to Body as shown in photo. Sew Legs and Tail to body as shown in photo, stuffing as you work. Refer to tutorial video here for comprehensive finishing instructions.

gauge: 16 sc = 4”; 16 rounds = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HEAD & BODY
With A, ch 4; join with a slip st into a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; join.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join – 16 sts.
Round 3: Repeat Round 2 – 32 sts.
Round 4: Ch 1, * sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 40 sts.
Rounds 5-12: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join.
Round 13: Ch 1, * sc in next 2 sts, skip next st, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join – 32 sts.
Round 14: Repeat Round 5.
Round 15: Ch 1, * sc in next 2 sts, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 24 sts.
Round 16: Ch 1, * sc in next st, skip next st; repeat from * around; join – 12 sts. Stuff Head with fiberfill.
Rounds 17-18: Repeat Round 5.
Round 19: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join – 24 sts.
Round 20: Repeat Round 5.
Round 21: Ch 1, * sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 32 sts.
Round 22: Ch 1, * sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 48 sts.
Round 23: Ch 1, * sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 64 sts.
Rounds 24-32: Repeat Round 5.
Round 33: Ch 1, * sc in next 2 sc, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 48 sts.
Round 34: Repeat Round 5.
Round 35: Ch 1, * sc in next 2 sts, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 36 sts.
Round 36: Repeat Round 5. Stuff Body with fiberfill.
Round 37: Ch 1, * sc in next st, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 24 sts.
Round 38: Repeat Round 37 – 16 sts.
Round 39: Ch 1, * sc in next 2 sts, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 12 sts.
Round 40: Repeat Round 39 – 9 sts.
Round 41: Ch 1, * sc in next 2 sts, skip next st; repeat from * around; join – 6 sts.
Round 42: [Slip st in next st, skip next st, slip st in next st] 2 times; fasten off.
MUZZLE
With A, ch 4; join with a slip st into a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; join.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join – 16 sts.
Round 3: Ch 1, * sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 24 sts.
Rounds 4-6: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join.
Round 7: Ch 1, * sc in next st, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 16 sts. Fasten off. Stuff Muzzle with fiberfill.
NOSE
With B, ch 3; join with a slip st into a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; join.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join. Fasten off. Stuff Nose with fiberfill.

FOOT (Make 2)
With A, ch 4; join with a slip st into a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; join.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join – 16 sts.
Round 3: Ch 1, * [2 sc in next st] 2 times; sc in next 6 sts; repeat from * around; join – 20 sts.
Round 4: Ch 1, * sc in next st, [2 sc in next st] 2 times; sc in next 7 sts; repeat from * around; join – 24 sts.
Rounds 5-10: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join.
Round 11: Ch 1, * sc in next 2 sts, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 18 sts.
Rounds 12-13: Repeat Round 5.
Round 14: Ch 1, * sc in next st, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 12 sts.
Round 15: Repeat Round 14 – 8 sts.
Round 16: Ch 1, * sc in next st, skip next st; repeat from * around; join – 4 sts.
Round 17: Slip st in next st, skip next st, slip st in next st. Fasten off. Stuff Foot with fiberfill.
Toes: [With A and yarn needle, sew through top of foot and secure] 2 times.

ARM (Make 2)
With A, ch 4; join with a slip st into ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; join.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join – 16 sts.
Round 3: Ch 1, * 2 sc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 24 sts.
Rounds 4-7: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join.
Round 8: Ch 1, * sc in next st, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 16 sts.
Round 9: Repeat Round 4.
Round 10: Ch 1, * sc in next 2 sts, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 12 sts.
Rounds 11-16: Repeat Round 4.
Round 17: Ch 1, * sc in next st, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 8 sts.
Round 18: Ch 1, * sc in next st, skip next st; repeat from * around; join – 4 sts.
Round 19: Ch 1, sc in next st, skip next st, sc in next st, slip st in next st. Fasten off. Stuff Arm with fiberfill.
Fingers: [With A, sew through top of arm and secure] 2 times.

EAR (Make 2)
With A, ch 6; turn.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 4 ch; rotate Ear to work in unused loops of beginning ch, sc in next 5 ch; join – 10 sts.
Rounds 2-3: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join.
Round 4: Ch 1, * 2 sc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 15 sts.
Rounds 5-8: Repeat Round 2.
Round 9: Ch 1, * sc in next st, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 10 sts.
Rounds 10-11: Repeat Round 2.
Round 12: Ch 1, * sc in next 2 sts, skip next st, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join – 8 sts.
Rounds 13: Repeat Round 2.
Round 14: Ch 1, * sc in next 2 sts, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join – 6 sts.
Round 15: Ch 1, * sc in next 2 sts, skip next st; repeat from * around; join – 4 sts.
Round 16: Ch 1, sc in next st, skip next st, sc in next st, slip st in next st. Fasten off. Stuff Ear with fiberfill.
Inner Ear: With B, embroider the center of Ear. Fasten off.

TAIL
With A, make a 1” pompom.

FINISHING
Sew Arms and Feet to body. Secure Tail to back of body. Sew Ears to top of Head and tack sides of each Ear together at base of each ear. Sew Muzzle to front of Head. Run long stitch from center of Muzzle to base of Muzzle and pull tightly; secure and fasten off to form mouth. Sew Nose at join between top of Muzzle and Head. With C, embroider eyes on Head. Weave in ends.
Tie ribbon in bow around neck and trim ends.

materials: 1 ball 9521 Sugar Skull
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 3.5 mm [US E-4]
Stitch marker, stuffing, yarn needle.
Optional: Knee high stocking and plastic pellets for weighted stuffing.
abbreviations: A, B, C, and D = Color A, Color B, Color C, and Color D
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 21 sts = about 4" [10 cm]; 25 rounds = about 4" [10 cm] in single crochet (sc). EXACT GAUGE IS NOT CRITICAL TO THIS PROJECT. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
SKULL
Beginning at top of skull, with A or B, ch 3; slip st in first ch to form a ring. 
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st around—12 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: Sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 5 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in last st—24 sc.
Round 5: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: Sc in next 2 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] 5 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts—36 sc.
Round 7: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] 6 times—42 sc.
Round 8: Sc in next 3 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts] 5 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts—48 sc.
Rounds 9–17: Sc in each st around.
Begin stuffing piece with fiberfill or place optional knee high, filled with plastic pellets, into place. Continue stuffing piece with fiberfill as work progresses.
Round 18: Sc in next 3 sts, [sc2tog, sc in next 6 sts] 5 times, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts—42 sc.
Round 19: [Sc2tog, sc in next 5 sts] 6 times—36 sc.
Round 20: Sc in next 2 sts, [sc2tog, sc in next 4 sts] 5 times, sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts—30 sc.
Rounds 21–26: Sc in each st around.
Round 27: [Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts] 6 times—24 sc.
Stuff piece.
Round 28: Sc in next st, [sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts] 5 times, sc2tog, sc in next st—18 sc.
Round 29: [Sc2tog] 9 times—9 sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. Secure tail and weave to inside of skull.

FLOWER EYES (make 2 for each skull)
Note: If you are making A-colored skull, work Round 1 with C and Round 2 with D. If you are making B-colored skull, work Round 1 with D and Round 2 with C.
Ch 3; slip st in first ch to form a ring. 
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 10 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—10 sc. 
Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, draw up a loop of next color in same sc as joining slip st, [ch 2, 2 dc in next st, ch 2, slip st in next st] 5 times—5 petals. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing flower eye to skull. Weave in beginning tail.

HEAD FLOWERS (make 3 for each skull)
Note: If you are making A-colored skull, make 1 flower each with B, C and D. If you are making B-colored skull, make 1 flower each with A, C and D.
Ch 3; slip st in first ch to form a ring. 
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 10 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—10 sc. 
Round 2: Ch 2, 2 dc in same st as joining slip st, ch 2, slip st in next st, [ch 2, 2 dc in next st, ch 2, slip st in next st] 4 times—5 petals.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing flower to skull. Weave in beginning tail.

FINISHING
Referring to photograph as a guide to placement, use yarn tails or yarn scraps to sew the following pieces together.
1. Sew flower eyes to front of skull.
2. Sew head flowers to top of skull, positioned as desired. Use contrasting color yarn to embroider a star stitch through the center of flowers and to top of head, leaving petals free.

Facial Features
Note: If you are making A-colored skull, embroider features with B. If you are making B-colored skull, embroider features with A.
Mouth: Using photograph as a guide, embroider straight stitch mouth. Embroider a long horizontal line then embroider short vertical lines evenly spaced over the top of the horizontal line.
Nose: Using photograph as a guide, embroider two chain stitches for nostrils. Position the narrow ends of the chain stitches together at top and between eyes for top of nose. Position the wide ends of the chain stitches about two rounds below and side by side.
Weave in and trim any remaining ends.
